story.title: Malini's Experience with Bad Touch.
paragraphs_en: Malini's birthday just passed by. She was a very happy 13 year old. Unlike many of her classmates, she loved the whole journey of growing up, meeting new people, solving problems on her own. Her mother always encouraged her to not be afraid of changes. Her mother was a very busy person. She managed household, went out to work and also did a lot of volunteer activities. Malini always considered her as one of the inspirations, right from her childhood.

Malini's childhood was a very happy one. She was always exposed to a lot of baby-sitters. Malini loved that experience! Every baby-sitter used to treat her with so much of love and she always remembered to be thankful for the same. One of her favourite baby-sitters is Taklu Uncle and his family. They used to take care of her like a princess!Taklu uncle always used to give Malini toffees! He knew Malini loved them.

Anyways, coming back to her teenage years, Malini also noticed that with each birthday,her body changes. She was so puzzled and sometimes disgusted. Why do bodies have to change? Is it not enough that her teachers, her grades,her friends and her eating habits were changing?Now her body is also changing? Malini was so curious about hair in her armpit.

The next day, Taklu Uncle came with a jar of toffees! Imagine,a whole jar of toffees! She was so thrilled. Uncle said,'You are growing up so fast and I am unable to believe it" Come here and take these toffees. Hey! you have changed a lot." Saying this, he took her hand and he slowly moved his hands to those two small bulging dots that were appearing on Malini's chest. Malini was feeling a little weird.

Well, Taklu uncle always touched her hand and hugged her since childhood. but it wasn't uncomfortable. This touch right then was making her feel very queasy. Will uncle stop giving her toffees if she tells this to someone? He is anyways the favourite uncle of everyone!He makes everyone laugh, does Yoga and keeps everyone happy. Who will believe her?

That night, she kept looking at the jar of toffees. She sat her parents down and told the entire story. Her mother said " It was very brave of you to open up like this! Good girl. You must not encourage any kind of touch that makes you feel uncomfortable. Please come and tell us always in case you someone misbehaves with you. And if someone does touch you like that again, scream. We are always there for you and we love you".

She was glad that she told her parents this incident. She was very proud of herself. She threw the toffees outside the window. She told herself that it is okay if Taklu uncle didn't give her toffees. But it is never okay for anyone to make her experience an uncomfortable touch. She can allow people to hug and touch her only if she consents to it. Malini felt so relieved.
